title: satureja alpina var. amplifoliata
intro: Satureja alpina var. amplifoliata, commonly known as Alpine savory, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine savory include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Alpine savory include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
